name: io.github.glincker/levelrail
description: Self-hosted MCP server for your Levelrail deployments, servers, databases and domains.

environmentVariables.name: APP_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your Levelrail control plane API, for example https://levelrail.example.com.

environmentVariables.name: APP_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token created on your Levelrail instance.

environmentVariables.name: APP_MCP_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Tool exposure: read-only, standard (default) or full.
